prompt:
Create exactly ONE full-body transparent cutout of an original MASS EFFECT 1 VARREN, faithfully matching the native gameplay references. Use the standing, snarling Varren on the LEFT side of reference image 1 as the identity, posture, face and color authority. Image 2 shows the same game's Varren after combat: use its foreground animal only to resolve the complete side and rear body, dorsal armor, row of pink flank marks, small tail shape and rear paws, NOT the collapsed pose. Image 3 shows the same model lifted by a biotic power; use it only to check limb connections and underside, NOT the blue effects or upside-down pose. This is the pale gray/black ME1 animal, not an ME2 green/red/yellow Varren, not ME3 Jack's pet, and not a dog, crocodile or generic dinosaur.

The creature is a stocky four-legged alien animal with pale gray pebbled skin, thick chest, relatively short trunk, wide blunt fish-like black head, very large dark round bulbous lateral eyes with small warm brown highlights, tiny pointed teeth and four long thin off-white saber-like fangs around the open pink mouth. Preserve the high black dorsal ridge/plates running continuously from the broad head down the back toward the short tapering pale tail, and the small raised dorsal spikes. Preserve the single row of rounded pinkish fleshy spots along each pale flank, also present on the tail base, exactly as the game references show. Preserve the compact muscular front shoulders, narrower bent hind legs, dark black toes/claws and feet shapes from the screenshots. Do not add ears, a nose like a dog, horns, a tongue hanging out, fur, scales larger than the original texture, armor, harness or new markings.

Pose and camera: grounded alert standing snarl, four paws planted, slight frontal three-quarter view matching the LEFT Varren of image 1 while showing enough side for the dorsal ridge, flank spots and full short tail to read. Reconstruct only the small rear portions corroborated by images 2 and 3, keeping the original anatomy and proportions. Do not make a jumping or lying animal. Entire silhouette must be inside the canvas, including all four feet, the jaw/fangs, raised head spines and tail tip. Use a landscape composition with the subject no larger than 75 percent of the canvas width or height so at least 12 percent transparent margin surrounds it. Original game-model texture/stylization, neutral balanced lighting, no dramatic blue or orange stage illumination. Exactly one animal. Fully transparent alpha background with clean crisp antialiased edges. No ambient glow, translucent haze, shadow, ground, smoke, fire, rubble, biotic effect, other Varren, Shepard, Wrex, stage, UI, text, collage or other views. This is a faithful static creature master, not a redesign.
